name: Sato Corp
summary: Sato Holdings Corporation, founded in Tokyo, Japan in 1940, is a global enterprise dedicated to the design, production, and sale of labeling products. The company's operations are divided into three core segments: Auto-ID Solutions (Japan), Auto-ID Solutions (Overseas), and Inline Digital Printing (IDP). Their comprehensive offering includes a variety of printers, hand labelers, and essential consumables such as barcode labels, stickers, primary labels, and radio frequency identification (RFID) tags. Beyond physical products, Sato delivers a suite of services, including troubleshooting assistance and maintenance. They also provide integrated solutions comprising hardware, consumables, maintenance services, and software, often demonstrating clear return on investment. Notable services include SATO Online Services, a cloud-based monitoring platform for printers that facilitates preventive maintenance and immediate issue resolution. Additionally, the company offers consultation services, develops specialized application software, and ensures seamless integration with ERP, WMS, and MDM systems. Sato Holdings caters to a diverse range of industries, including retail/apparel, manufacturing, food, transport and logistics, and healthcare.
